title: Area Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 TGL Co. (The Good Life Company) is dedicated to making the world’s finest teas and blends an accessible everyday luxury that reflects sophistication, calm, and well\-being. The company focuses on reviving and redefining the tea experience by sourcing premium teas from the regions where they grow best and pairing them with innovative flavors and botanicals. Each blend is crafted to deliver distinctive aroma, flavor, and a harmonious taste profile that surprises and delights tea enthusiasts. Inspired by the historic Ancient Tea Horse route, TGL Co. aims to lead tea into a new era of excellence, appealing to a growing community of modern tea aficionados. The brand positions tea not just as a legacy beverage, but as an exciting, rejuvenating drink for contemporary lifestyles.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Area Sales Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kochi, responsible for driving sales growth and brand visibility for TGL Co. in the assigned territory. On a day\-to\-day basis, the role involves identifying and onboarding new retail and institutional customers, managing relationships with existing accounts, and achieving monthly and quarterly sales targets. The Area Sales Executive will conduct regular market visits, monitor stock levels and merchandising standards, and coordinate with distributors and retail partners to ensure product availability and visibility. The role also includes collecting market intelligence, analyzing sales performance, and sharing feedback with the internal team to refine pricing, promotions, and product strategies. Collaboration with marketing and operations teams to support local campaigns, sampling activities, and in\-store promotions is an integral part of the position.

* Strong sales and business development skills, with experience in field sales, territory management, and customer acquisition.
* Ability to build and maintain long\-term client relationships, including negotiation, account management, and stakeholder communication.
* Basic analytical and reporting skills, including tracking sales performance, understanding market trends, and using MS Excel or similar tools.
* Familiarity with FMCG or beverage industry practices, such as distribution networks, merchandising, and retail operations, is highly beneficial.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of local languages in Kochi is an advantage.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a target\-driven environment with frequent market visits.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred; relevant sales experience may be considered in place of formal education.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory and work flexible hours when required for client meetings or promotional events.

Tuck allows shoppers to see garments on their own photos, matched perfectly with brand size charts, directly driving up merchant conversions.

Our leadership team has a proven track record of building category\-defining technology, having previously built India’s first cashierless store technology which was successfully acquired by Amazon.

*Crucially: You won’t spend your days hunting for leads.*

 ₹40,000 – ₹60,000 monthly, commensurate with experience.

 Uncapped per\-client bonuses scaled to the plan they choose.
* **Recurring Commission:** 
 5% of your client's monthly subscription fee for their first 12 months. Your income grows with your book of business.

 Realistic OTE (On\-Target Earnings) for a strong performer is
 **₹1,00,000 – ₹1,25,000/month**

 Comfortable owning a revenue target, managing a pipeline, and navigating the reality of B2B sales.

 Familiarity with Shopify/e\-commerce ecosystems, strong CRM discipline, and experience in international markets.

 You will work directly with the founders, receiving hands\-on product training from day one. You are joining early enough that whoever successfully builds this function will eventually lead it.
